findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data on page

suggested_action.summary: Add JSON-LD (Organization/Product/Article as appropriate) with the page's core facts so assistants can extract them unambiguously.

findings.title: No breadcrumb or active-section indicator found
findings.evidence: No breadcrumb element and no nav item with aria-current found in the page HTML.

suggested_action.summary: Add a breadcrumb trail or highlight the active section in navigation so visitors landing deep can orient immediately.
Publish a sitemap.xml listing all indexable URLs and reference it in robots.txt so new/updated pages are discovered faster.
Add a unique meta description summarizing the page's key facts in plain text.

findings.title: No freshness/date signal found on page
findings.evidence: No dateModified/datePublished JSON-LD, date meta tags, or visible 'last updated' text found on https://example.com.

suggested_action.summary: Add a dateModified field to JSON-LD and/or a visible 'Last updated' line for time-sensitive content.

findings.title: No visible contact path or trust/legitimacy signal
findings.evidence: No contact/support wording and no review/testimonial/certification wording found on page.

suggested_action.summary: Add a visible contact/support link and at least one legitimacy signal (reviews, case studies, credentials) appropriate to the page.

findings.title: Context retention across client-side navigation not verified
findings.evidence: This check requires executing JavaScript / simulating navigation and was not run in static-HTML mode.

suggested_action.summary: Re-run with a browser-rendering tool to confirm selections/filters survive back-navigation.

findings.title: Interstitials / autoplay / layout shift not verified
findings.evidence: These are runtime behaviors and were not confirmed in static-HTML mode.

suggested_action.summary: Re-run with a browser-rendering tool to observe first-paint behavior directly.
